reuse.why: The change extends getScheduledAmount but bypasses it in the API adapter and duplicates the existing getApproxNumberThreshold calculation.

duplication.why: Expected-amount dispatch is independently implemented in scheduleModel.toExternal, and approximate tolerance arithmetic is copied from shared/rules.ts.

placement.why: The shared schedules module appropriately owns planning policy, but the API serialization layer also embeds its own version of that policy.

scope.why: The edits are confined to schedule amount planning, API exposure, associated types, and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Independent policy implementations, an unused rangeRounding parameter, and a loosely typed fourth positional argument make future rule changes harder to maintain consistently.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts computes expectedAmount without getScheduledAmount; shared/schedules.ts calculates tolerance without getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: scheduleModel.toExternal reshapes getScheduledAmount's missing/number/range dispatch into nested ternaries, creating a separate policy implementation rather than sharing it.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains amountOp and an isapprox branch while retaining the now-unused rangeRounding parameter; scheduleModel.toExternal independently implements expected-amount selection.
